why: The variadic-to-fixed-arity narrowing is the archetypal 'what would break if the signature changed' question, and it is the exact question bench/grep-vs-seam case 1 asks in prose. Here tsc answers it instead of an agent. Every call site passing other than 2 arguments must break; Seam can predict the COUNT from its arity histogram, which is a claim that is either right or wrong.
